## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text — the first of two parallel Taishō recensions (T0315a and [T0315b](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0007)) — is [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's translation of the *Pǔ mén pǐn jīng* (a chapter on the *Universal Gate* doctrine, a *bodhisattva*-path text). The text was incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* as assembly 10 (*Wénshūshīlì pǔ mén huì* 文殊師利普門會).

**Abstract**

The translation is conventionally datable to [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's translation activity at Cháng'ān, c. 266 – 313 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The Taishō prints two recensions of the same translation as T0315a and T0315b; the *a* recension corresponds to the Korean *Tripiṭaka Koreana* witness, while T0315b is from another transmission line. The two preserve substantially the same translation in slightly different states.

The Taishō text (T0315a) is established on the Korean *Tripiṭaka Koreana* witness.
